内置站点提供官方组件；自定义站点支持 Android SDK 仓库 XML（re: Built-in sources provide official components. Custom sources support Android SDK repository XML (repository / remotePackage format). Enabled sources are used for catalog refresh and installation.

2～128 GiB，不自动清除已有用户数据。已有分区是否扩容由模拟器处理。: 2–128 GiB. Existing user data is preserved; the emulator determines whether an existing partition can grow.

选择现有 .img 文件；配置变更不会格式化该文件。: Choose an existing .img file. Configuration changes do not format it.
目录必须包含 layout 文件；分辨率应与皮肤匹配。: The folder must contain a layout file. Its resolution should match the device.
配置在下次启动时生效。内部名称、系统镜像及已有用户数据保留；未修改的配置键保持原: Configuration takes effect at the next boot. Internal name, system image and user data are preserved. Unchanged keys retain their original values.
配置已在其他工具中更新，请关闭后重新打开编辑面板。: Configuration was changed by another tool. Close and reopen the editor.

忽略会删除对应的本地缓存；已另存文件、原始采集段和任务记录保留。: Discarding deletes the corresponding cached copies. Saved files, original recordings and task history are kept.
